profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at Google
profile.summary:
An honors Yale graduate in Computer Science with decades of industry experience as a software engineer and technical leader.

• Outstanding technical skills.  Over twenty years of professional programming experience.  Well-versed in object-oriented techniques, design patterns, concurrency, data modeling, database design, system architecture, system security, cloud architecture and performance & scalability techniques.

• Experienced software developer and technical lead.  Led the design and construction of dozens of successful working systems.  Seasoned in all phases of the software development lifecycle.  Known for building unusually bug-free and maintainable software.

• Exceptional analytical skills.  A gift for understanding complex problems, generating conceptual clarity and creating optimal solutions given the real-world constraints.

• Outstanding ability to explain complex concepts verbally and in writing.  Have created many technical write-ups that have stood the test of time as the essential go-to guide for that concept.  Have taught 20+ lectures on topics (such as Java 8 features, Unicode, coding standards, software quality, the architecture of our software systems, etc.).

• Focused on the customer and the bottom line.  Skilled at collaborating and pragmatically weighing the tangible and intangible benefits of an initiative against the costs and then proactively managing risk to ensure success.

Specialties: Software Architecture, Object-Oriented Design, Data Communications, Databases, SaaS, Distributed Systems, Software Quality, Cloud Computing, Java, Gradle, AWS.

positions.title: Technical Director
positions.description:
•	Architect and technical lead for the DLP private and public cloud (AWS) initiatives.  My architecture is the foundation for a fast growing ($50m+/year) cloud service business.
•	Participant in the global cloud architects team working on unifying Symantec’s enterprise security products.
•	Leader/mentor/reviewer/analyst contributor on many in-flight projects.
•	Created and taught a lecture series for the developers on Java 8 features (Lambdas/Streams/Generics), design patterns, Unicode, coding standards, and other topics.

positions.title: Sr. Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Project lead for highly-scalable distributed communications platform to handle millions of endpoints.
•	Project lead for initiative to support multi-version staggered upgrade for a distributed multi-server product.
•	As a member of the senior leads team, proposed multiple architectural, conceptual and technical strategy improvements for moving the product forward.
•	Wrote functional specs for a major new product feature.  Designed the batch mode reporting capability.
•	Contributor and reviewer on multiple areas of the code base.  Proactively refactored multiple subsystems and database tables to improve performance, correctness and maintainability.

positions.title: VP of Software Engineering
positions.description: Formerly, SmartPatents, Inc.  Developer and then manager working on software to automate patent portfolio management.

patents.title: Partial Risk Score Calculation for a Data Object
Method to calculate a risk score of a folder that has been scanned for confidential information
